name: Career Achievers Program and Graduate Accelerator Program
summary: Funding for equity undergraduates' professional development, placements, internships or global mobility activities.
who: Currently enrolled domestic undergraduates in particular program areas.
Low-SES, regional or remote, and/or First Nations students.
First-years use the Career Achievers Program; later years use the Graduate Accelerator Program.
how: Apply through the UniHub form linked from Griffith's other financial support page.
catches: Griffith doesn't publish the amounts on this page.

evidence.quote: Financial support for professional development, work readiness, placement, internship, or global mobility activities
